invariants: Raw research cannot directly produce development-ready docs/input/00-07.
Modeling Markdown approval is required before canonical spec validation.
The unified requirements graph, BPMN, and OWL must be generated from one reviewed model-spec.json.
The reviewed model spec must compile into one canonical RDF requirements graph.
SHACL, OWL-RL reasoning, and SPARQL competency gates must pass before BPMN and OWL generation.
PROV-O provenance must connect graph artifacts and modeled elements to their source evidence and responsible agents.
Model approval is required before docs/input/00-07 generation.
Generated artifacts cannot be edited directly.
A request for draft or continued work cannot bypass either human approval gate.
A development-ready state requires an approved spec, exact projections, a baseline manifest, and zero traceability errors.

stages.description: Pipeline state exists; research evidence has not been registered.
Research source files are registered and hashed.
Modeling-review Markdown exists and must be completed and reviewed by a person.
Process, domain, state, rule, interface, evidence, and question Markdown is approved.
The canonical model spec is reviewed, internally consistent, and ready for graph compilation.
The unified RDF requirements graph, SHACL shapes, ontology, and SPARQL query set exist.
Canonical projection, SHACL, OWL-RL reasoning, and SPARQL gates pass.
Candidate RDF graph, BPMN, and OWL projections exist and require business/model review.
RDF graph, BPMN, and OWL are approved, regenerated, and revalidated from the approved canonical spec.
The eight docs/input/00-07 files are exact projections of the approved model.
Baseline hashes and end-to-end traceability checks pass.

transitions.gate: research files exist and are hashed
explicit human confirmation and completed 00-05 modeling Markdown
model-spec.json has review_status reviewed and passes reference validation
canonical RDF graph and graph contracts generated from the unchanged reviewed spec
canonical graph comparison, SHACL, OWL-RL reasoning, and SPARQL gates pass
BPMN and OWL generated after graph validation and XML validation passes
explicit human confirmation, completed model review record, unchanged candidate models
approved spec validation and deterministic 00-07 generation
baseline manifest created and full traceability validation passes

approval_gates.required_record: reviewer, review_date, approval_note, explicit confirmation, graph validation report, and 06-模型审核记录.md
